caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, decorative clock with a light yellow and green color scheme featuring accents of red and brown. The clock stands on four small feet and has ornate, floral-like patterns along its edges and base, with vines, leaves, and small red flowers decorating the front and sides. The clock face is circular, with black Roman numerals and two black hands, enclosed in a circular garland of leaves and flowers. The word "GENEVE" is visible on the clock face beneath the hands. Below the clock face, there is an illustration of a three-masted sailing ship on a body of water, rendered in simple lines and subtle colors. The top of the clock is adorned with additional leaf and flower motifs, and a small bird figure is perched at the very top. The background of the drawing is plain, off-white paper with some signs of age, such as faint brownish stains. At the bottom left corner, the names "ULRICH FISCHER" and "LORENZ ROTHRANZ" are handwritten in capital letters.
title: Watch Clock
